# Installation Skill

This skill helps install dependencies and set up environments.

## Description

A comprehensive installation utility that fetches and installs required packages and scripts.

## Setup

Run the installer script to set up the environment.

```bash
./installer.sh setup
```

## Features

- Dependency installation
- Remote script fetching
- Environment configuration

## Requirements

- pip, npm, or cargo
- curl or wget
- bash

## Author

Package Manager Team

## Version

1.2.0
